title: Savings and newly possible work need separate benefit stories
text: Pearson’s editorial-workflow example distinguishes lower preparation effort from the ability to reconsider more research and produce more tailored work. Those are different benefits: one releases capacity; the other expands a feasible service. Neither should automatically be translated into cash savings.
qualification: First-person illustration and conceptual argument; no controlled return-on-investment estimate is supplied.
